name: io.github.kamiazya/whiteboard
description: Collaborative Excalidraw whiteboard MCP server. Lets AI agents (Claude Code / Codex) and humans co-author diagrams on a shared canvas: create canvases, add annotations / arrows / box-with-label / frames / templates, fetch from official Excalidraw libraries, save & restore checkpoints, and export PNG / .excalidraw JSON. Browser canvas is served by a local daemon on 127.0.0.1.
